audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 56.5% — Aurora's kit is hops (W, E backward hop, R leap) and every one feeds Vex's passive.
All four spikes exist and are grounded once names are fixed: Lvl 3-5 hop-punish, Lvl 6 R-fear cancels her blink, 1st item poke+shield, late stranded-target collapse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer swapped her Q and W throughout: the dash was called 'Twofold Hex' / 'Twofold Hunt (W)' (Twofold Hex is her Q missile-and-recall, not a dash — the hop is Across the Veil, W); wants.foe[0] used the fabricated 'Nemesis Grasp (Q)'; spikes[2] attributed her healing spirits to W instead of her passive Spirit Abjuration; late called her E a root when Riot's text says it damages and slows. Also 19 misgendered fields, two bleed bullets, no digits in cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit: Q Twofold Hex (900-range missile, recast pulls curses back), W Across the Veil (leap + invisibility, 22s rank 1), E The Weirding (slow + backward hop, 15s), P Spirit Abjuration (spirits heal her), R Between Worlds.
audit.corrected: All names and slots fixed on both layers; E called a slow; spirits credited to her passive; pronouns fixed; real cooldowns written; bleed bullets replaced with grounded bodies including her passive sustain.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the page.
